description:
• Develop and maintain data pipelines and existing data solutions.
• Monitor data processes and support troubleshooting when data issues occur.
• Work with data models and semantic models/layers to support reporting and analytics.
• Work with large datasets and MPP (Massively Parallel Processing) -based data platforms.
• Develop and optimize SQL queries and data transformations.
• Support ETL/ELT processes and Data Warehouse activities.
• Work closely with Data/BI and business teams to understand requirements and provide
appropriate data solutions.
• Ensure data accuracy, quality, and system reliability.
requirements_text:
• 2+ years of experience in Data Engineering, BI, or a related field.
• Good knowledge of SQL and databases.
• Experience with ETL/ELT, data pipelines, or Data Warehouse.
• Experience or understanding of Semantic Models / Semantic Layers.
• Familiarity with MPP or large-scale data processing is preferred.
• Experience in maintaining or supporting existing data systems is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python is preferred but not mandatory.
• Good problem-solving and communication skills.
• Able to communicate in English in a working environment.
